title: Affine perfect replacement with a quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let $Y$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], with derived localizations for its module category and each localized open site [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $D$ be a cochain complex of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], strictly zero above a natural degree $d$, whose terms are quasi-coherent. Suppose its derived image is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then there exist a complex $C$, an integer $a$, a natural $b$, and a quasi-isomorphism $e:C\to D$ such that $C$ is strictly zero outside $[a,b]$ and every term is quasi-coherent, finitely presented and flat over the identity of $Y$ [def-pc-morphism-conventions]. No comparison with higher direct images is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary affine section-model theorem to obtain a bounded ring complex P with finite projective terms and a derived isomorphism to the section complex of D.

The upper bound gives IsStrictlyLE P. Install the projective term instances and use Mathlib isKProjective_of_projective. Apply the existing IsKProjective.exists_Q_map_eq to represent the derived isomorphism by q. Its Q-image is invertible, hence q is a quasi-isomorphism by isIso_Q_map_iff_quasiIso.

Apply affine_projective_sections_sheafification to q. Use the explicit termwise functor to transport zero terms, producing the lower strict bound a. Replace the upper integer bound b by b.toNat using b <= (b.toNat : Z), yielding all witnesses of the unchanged statement.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_perfect_flat_model_replacement (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : IsAffine Y) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ V : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over V))] (D : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hDle : D.IsStrictlyLE d) (hDqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsQuasicoherent) (hperfect : Y.IsPerfect ((DerivedCategory.Q (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))).obj D)) : ∃ (C : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ), C.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ C.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 Y)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧ ∃ e : C ⟶ D, QuasiIso e
